As my setups are becoming more complex, my #13 Kodak safelights were not providing enough light. while scanning the aisles at the local toy store i noticed this little amber LED flash light for $5 , well it works great I always keep it at an arms length from the film and I’ve had no fogging ...........

![Image](http://www.flashlightmuseum.com/flashlights/EV01000.jpg)

[http://www.flashlightmuseum.com/Everead ... Light-2008](http://www.flashlightmuseum.com/Eveready-Flashlight-WAL2ACS-Disney-Wall-E-LED-Squeeze-Light-or-Wall-Es-Eve-LED-Squeeze-Light-2008)

here's another tip, currently Fuji has discontined the manufature of this film, in order to clear their shelves of this film fuji, they are having a "fire sale" on the stuff ! At $80 per box (30x40 cms 10/pck), i suggest all to grab a box or two befor its all gone!
